title: Netflix Tudum
blurb: TU-DUM — two notes that start a billion evenings and signal that the next several hours are now spoken for. Netflix commissioned it as deliberate sonic branding, and it worked so completely that the company later named an entire fan event after it. Part of the trick is brevity: it's over before you can get bored, but long enough to feel like a curtain rising. Use it in edits to announce something dramatic beginning, or in real life before any story worth sitting down for.
